text:
ana: deploy-bot flagged a release notes mismatch for v2.7.3 during the morning window. Notes mention a Dedicated-only flag `--dedicated-bump`, but the binary in hosted pool fails on unknown flag.

deploy-bot: Rule RN-310 triggered: release_notes_dedicated_flag_mismatch. Options: (1) pause rollout, (2) rollback hosted to v2.7.2, (3) ship hotfix that gates flag behind env var.

ops-jorge: Important nuance: this impacts Dedicated customers if they receive the new image via their reserved pool. Do we know which pools got the image?

ana: Canary traffic shows only hosted nodes picked it up so far, but dedicated push workflow started and some images are already in dedicated registry.

cass: If we rollback hosted, we should also warn Dedicated infra teams — they may need to re-pull. Rolling back hosted keeps Dedicated untouched, but docs say feature is Dedicated-only so mismatch is confusing.

pm-lena: From product POV, we prefer not to expose the flag until Dedicated infra is ready. Rollback hosted and hold Dedicated push for a coordinated re-release. Less risk for customers.

ops-jorge: Operationally rollback hosted -> run `deployctl traffic pin --to v2.7.2 --percent 100` then trigger rollback job. ETA ~18m. Hotfix path (gate behind env var) ~50m and we'd still need to coordinate Dedicated push.

support-rya: I'll draft a short CSM note: "Paused rollout after docs/binary mismatch; no customer impact observed on hosted; Dedicated push on hold."

ana: Agreed. Let's rollback hosted now, hold Dedicated promotion, and open a follow-up to coordinate a combined v2.7.4 release that includes Dedicated rollout notes.

ops-jorge: Running commands: `deployctl pause --release v2.7.3` -> paused. `deployctl traffic pin --to v2.7.2 --percent 100` -> applied. Starting rollback job `rollbackctl start --from v2.7.3 --to v2.7.2 --note "dedicated-flag-mismatch"`.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started. Notifying dedicated-registry team and on-call.

cass: I alerted dedicated-registry; holding the registry tag push and revoking the promotion token.

ops-jorge: Rollback completed. Hosted traffic back on v2.7.2. Health checks green.

pm-lena: Good catch. Follow-ups: RN-311 (gate changelog entries that add Dedicated-only flags), RN-312 (deploy checklist update to confirm registry pushes to Dedicated pools), and a short incident blurb for compliance.

ana: I'll file the tickets and draft the blurb. Closing thread once dedicated push is formally blocked and the incident note is posted.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete; v2.7.3 marked as rolled back for hosted. Dedicated promotion remains blocked."
